# Umbrella Corporation — The Hive Access Badge System (Complete Reference)

## Overview
The Hive Access Badge System is the official Umbrella Corporation credential creation and verification studio. It enables operatives, researchers, and security personnel to configure, inspect, share, and download print-ready Umbrella Corporation identification passes modeled strictly on verified facility prop specifications.

## Supported Credential Formats
1. **Personnel Identification Pass (Vertical White Card)**
   - **Header**: Extended bold "UMBRELLA CORPORATION" lockup.
   - **Emblem & Portrait**: Left 8-segment crimson/white Umbrella octagon alongside a red-framed operative portrait with adjustable zoom and horizontal/vertical alignment.
   - **Identity Band**: Full-width charcoal slate band displaying the operative's full name above a red monospaced `CLEARANCE LEVEL` indicator.
   - **Biometric & Optical Grid**: Left typewriter column (`Division`, `HEIGHT`, `WEIGHT`, `EYES`, `HAIR`) paired with a scannable high-density optical verification code.
   - **Footer**: *"This Identification is Property of the Umbrella Corporation"*.

2. **Facility Zone Keycard (Vertical Minimal Card)**
   - **Purpose**: Non-portrait departmental bulkhead and elevator keycard.
   - **Layout**: Top Umbrella Corporation header, large centered 8-segment Umbrella octagon, charcoal division bar (`Security`, `U.B.C.S.`, `Special Security`, `Lab Staff`, `Facility Ops`, `Executive`), red clearance sub-bar, and centered optical verification code.

3. **Classified Directorate Security Pass (Horizontal Black Card)**
   - **Orientation**: Landscape CR80 card format with brushed dark carbon finish and centered 3D Umbrella watermark.
   - **Left Column**: Operative portrait above a red-bordered `SECURITY LEVEL / CLEARANCE` block.
   - **Center Column**: `PERSONAL INFORMATION` block listing `NAME`, `YEAR OF BIRTH`, `SEX`, `BLOODTYPE`, `ACCESS`, `POSITION A`, `POSITION B`, and spaced numeric registry serial (`220-XXXXXXX-XXXX`).
   - **Right Column**: Dermal ridge fingerprint verification box above a metallic gold smart-card contact chip.
   - **Bottom Strip**: Full-width Code-128 barcode above the corporate motto *"OUR BUSINESS IS LIFE ITSELF"*.

## Authorized Umbrella Divisions
- Security Personnel
- U.B.C.S. (Umbrella Biohazard Countermeasure Service)
- U.S.S. (Umbrella Security Service)
- Virology & Research Division
- The Hive Facility Operations
- Executive Management

## Security Clearance Tiers
- **Level 1**: Surface Reception & Perimeter Transit
- **Level 2**: General Administration & Logistics Sub-Level
- **Level 3**: Bio-Containment Support & Diagnostics
- **Level 4**: Restricted Viral Testing & Sector B Labs
- **Level 5**: Deep Hive Operations & Red Queen Chamber
- **Clearance A**: Directorate Command — Unrestricted All Areas
